Many locations will try to find a problem even if there is nothing wrong so they can charge you for it, not Dale's Auto Services.

reviews.author: Pharaoh
reviews.text: I'm about to go on a road trip so I decided to go to Dale's Auto Services to ensure my car was good to go. Joe was absolutely fantastic; checked out my car, drove it around afterwards to make sure there were no issues, and after finding no issues he didn't charge me a dime. Many locations will try to find a problem even if there is nothing wrong so they can charge you for it, not Dale's Auto Services. Would recommend to family/friends!

reviews.author: Logan Bradley
reviews.text: Quick and seamless, they know how to solve problems fast they also make an effort to get you in and out and value your time very fairly priced as well.

reviews.author: Kristin Hubbard
reviews.text: I don’t ever leave reviews for anything but let me tell you that Dale’s is the most honest, affordable and hardworking set of mechanics I’ve encountered since I moved to NC 8+ years ago. I honestly trust them, value their honesty and pricing, and admire their commitment to treating me well. I’ll happily tell anyone and everyone to go see them.

reviews.author: Leanne Doty
reviews.text: Dale's was recommended to us by a good friend, and they're fantastic! Great service, reasonable prices, and very honest! We'll be back soon with my car.

reviews.author: Sharon Smith
reviews.text: Recently we have relocated but while we lived in Hendersonville they serviced our three vehicles for 20 yrs. Their service was everything we ever needed or could ask for! A great big thank you to Dale, Doug, Dennis,& Joe.

reviews.author: Mollie
reviews.text: Been going here since 2006, never been disappointed with their work, honesty, and professionalism. They know me by name and have never tried to updating. Very comfortable speaking to them as a woman, have never felt talked down to here! Highly recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: john vinicky
reviews.text: Was in from out of town with a potential issue. Dale was able to take a look and give us piece of mind. Very professional and clean shop!

reviews.author: Gregg Ganger
reviews.text: Dales is the best place to have your car repaired but I would not. I would not bring my car / truck to Full bore ever I mean ever again. I have brought my truck back 5. I said 5 times for engine leaks and or check engine light. At our expense. It is not worth going to getting your vehicle fixed. I have yet to have it repaired correctly still not right/ got it back “ again “ after five times back with a check engine w. I am so tired of bringing it back. Looking for some place that can do it right and be finished. Gregg

reviews.author: Pam Young
reviews.text: Great experience at Dale’s Auto Services. My mom’s car had developed a squeak in what we thought were the breaks. Made an appointment to have the brakes replaced. Dale called to verify what our concerns were. After evaluating the situation he called back to share the break pads were in excellent condition and to fix the squeak - which is not a safety issue and has no impact on the cars breaking ability - would be wasting our (my parent’s) money. It is rare to find a mechanic that recommends what is best for the customer and not their personal bottom line. Truly appreciated him evaluating the situation instead of just “doing what was scheduled”.

reviews.author: Jeannie Honeycutt
reviews.text: Dale and his team took such good care of me and my car needs. They got me and appointment quickly and gave my car the overhaul it needed. Efficient and reasonably priced. I will only be taking my car here. A big thanks to them for being the best! I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joan Mondrick
reviews.text: I’ve been taking my honda there since 2020 when I moved to Saluda. Great service, fair prices, and friendly and knowledgeable staff.

reviews.author: Bryan Glover
reviews.text: I’ve used Dale’s twice very recently (somewhat new to the area and went on a recommendation). In both instances I was extremely happy with the way my repair was handled and with the quality of the work done. Both times I was pleasantly surprised by the communication, timeliness and friendliness of the shop and everyone involved in comparison with other shops I’ve used in the past. At no point was I ever “sold” anything or pressured to make any purchases/repairs that weren’t completely necessary (even though there would have been ample opportunity if they were so inclined). They addressed my issues professionally and communicated during the entire process and made sure I was comfortable with any repairs to be made before they were done. The best part is that the repairs were done right the first time and they had me driving away fast without having to worry about any issues. I will 100% use Dale’s going forward and have no problem referring any of my friends and family over to those guys. Great work!

reviews.author: BritStyle Company
reviews.text: Over 1 year now with going to Dale’s. Great Service with unmatched Professionalism. Kind and respectful staff. Honest mechanics are very rare. One my second vehicle going to Dale’s. Very Dependable Place. Thank you Doug, Justin and Dale with all the right guys working there! Well done! Elle T.

reviews.author: johnathon rubio
reviews.text: Took my truck in for an oil leak and coolant leak. They took care of the coolant leak and said they took care of the oil leak. Truck leaks oil worse than before. They were very friendly and timely with the work. Just not satisfied with the results.

reviews.author: Tj jackson
reviews.text: Will never take out cars to dealerships again for maintenance. After being quoted $1500 in URGENT repairs, we took our truck to Dale's and that found nothing wrong! They could have easily agreed with All the repairs and had the extra business but couldn't in good faith do that. I've always been told to take your vehicles to someone you can trust.

reviews.author: Susan Ward
reviews.text: Dale's came recommended from a friend who had been going to them for 10 years. They are super nice, honest and trustworthy. We've taken two Subarus to them already just since the recommendation from our friend a couple of months ago. :)

reviews.author: Casey Corbin
reviews.text: My boyfriend and his Father have been using Dale’s for quite some time and have always had a good experience. If they weren’t satisfied with the outcome the first go around they would bring the car back and in and figure it out timely and at a great price. I recently took my 4Runner there with some knocking noises that could have been put off on very expensive repairs but they simply redid the rear brakes and tightened control arms for a great price. Nice people, nice work!

reviews.author: Jim Campbell
reviews.text: Dale's stood behind their work. I'll certainly have them work on my cars again. :) I had an intermittent problem with the engine occasionally not cranking and sometimes misfiring. Dales' replaced the starter motor and sparkplugs. After almost 5 months the starter motor sounded loud and different. Dale's replaced the motor with a new on at NO CHARGE!!! I love companies that stand behind their work.

reviews.author: Steve Jarrell
reviews.text: Very professional and competent work, friendly customer service, work is performed when it's promised and their prices are very fair and reasonable. I've dealt with Dale's Auto Services for years and I couldn't be happier. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Random Woman
reviews.text: I am a 67-year-old female who doesn't know much about vehicle repairs, but when I saw what I thought to be oil on my garage floor, I asked the repair shop I have been patronizing since 2013 to give me an estimate. I was told I had several moderate leaks and the estimate to repair would be close to $800. When I left their shop my check engine light was on and my cruise control was no longer working. I decided to take my car to Dale's to get a quote on the oil leak repairs. They cleaned the area where I was told the oil was "weeping," etc. and found it to be dry. They drove the car and still found no leaks. I left my car so they could determine if there was any leaking overnight. They drove it again and let it idle for a while, but they still found no leaks. With no evidence of leaks I was told they could not give me a quote on a repair that didn't need to be done. Wow! Also, I thought I was going to have to take my car to the dealership to have the cruise control fixed, but Dale was able to repair it at a very reasonable price. I will never go back to my local repair shop. Dale has my business from this day forth and forevermore!

reviews.author: Samuel Watson
reviews.text: I started bringing my vehicle here after I fired Firestone in Lenexa. The first time I brought my car in I couldn't get there to pick it up before they closed. Dale left the key in an agreed upon hidden spot and I was able to come by after hours and pick up my vehicle. Dale told me to simply come by the next day and pay. This is small town customer service like I have never seen before! I have used Dale twice now and the work performed has been honest and excellent and the customer service is way above excellent! This is the best car repair business I have ever seen. I am glad now that Firestone pissed me off.

reviews.author: Daniel Shirley
reviews.text: Sunday night my car broke down on the side of the road. Monday morning it was towed here, taken in quickly, and the issue was fixed before lunch. Not only was it fixed quickly, but they explained to us what happened to the car, what was being replaced, and how they were going to fix the issue. They were friendly and even offered to drive us to lunch if the car wouldn't be fixed before then. Highly recommend Dales.

reviews.author: Designer Window Fashions
reviews.text: Dale and his crew have been great! Thanks to the whole crew who worked hard to get me on my way. KUDOS. I can't thank you enough, Brenda N

reviews.author: STEVE JESPERSEN
reviews.text: I’ve had 2 of my vehicles worked on at Dales .. I dealt with Joe .he was great.. . they did the repairs in a timely manner and they went above and beyond ,by replacing a second part on my Mustang , but kept the original quote amount .. I would highly recommend them

reviews.author: Matt Freisleben
reviews.text: Our minivan stalled on the freeway back to Wisconsin. I found Dale's and they quickly identified the issue and made a temporary repair that got us safely back home. They were great and I was unbelievably appreciative they stopped their day to help me.

reviews.author: Heather Dobbs
reviews.text: Dale& his team are the most honest,genuine group.They keep in touch with you during your car repairs,if you drop it off. I have never had anything but excellent service& very fair prices. I want to say THANK YOU.

reviews.author: Brynn Pickett
reviews.text: I came all the way from Greer SC to get my brakes fixed here! I drove up and noticed about 13.6 billion cars in the parking lot and thought “no WAY am I getting my brakes fixed today!” But I went inside anyway and told them what was up and they asked for the keys and said they would “see what they could do”. I’ll admit, I didn’t have high hopes and I waited with my not-even-two-year-old daughter expecting them to say they could get to it in 4 hours after all these other folks, but I didn’t have anywhere else to go without my car. Well I was pleasantly surprised when they came back and told me what it needed, what it would cost ($300 cheaper than what I had been quoted at NTB in SC), and said it would take an hour to an hour and a half, tops. I waited with my little girl and they came back in 40 minutes and said it was done! I didn’t properly thank the thin young man with a fresh trendy haircut for recognizing my situation and getting me in on such short notice. It really meant a lot to me! So if any of the employees reads this and knows of a man who matches that description who remembers helping a young mom with a young daughter, please thank him for me as I didn’t catch his name!

reviews.author: Jennifer Hayes
reviews.text: I took my SUV to Dale's on my son's recommendation. The service was excellent and a fraction of the cost at the dealer. I will return as I know with 106000 miles it is bound to be something. Great to have a trusted mechanic.

reviews.author: Kristina Papke
reviews.text: DO NOT USE!!! THEY TAKE ADVANTAGE & OVERCHARGE! They prey on old women and younger aged women. They wanted over $2,000 to fix an oil leak for an elderly woman that’s a friend of mine and after getting a second opinion the oil levels were not low and there wasn’t a leak!! Please do yourself a favor, save money, & go elsewhere or at the very least get a second opinion!

reviews.author: Jordan Randall
reviews.text: Pathetic. Absolutely pathetic! 2 weeks and didn't even touch my car. Run around and run around and finally had to pick it up. Avoid at all cost. Useless!!! Would give zero stars if it was an option. They called me and were extremely hostile and unprofessional demanding that I pick the car up after leaving a negative review. Here is some advice. If you don't want negative reviews then don't treat your customers like garbage. Lost out on 3 cars worth of business as I will never go back. Ill ride a bike before taking my car to Dale's. They could have offered to make it right but chose to be completely unprofessional.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Wilson
reviews.text: Joe Villanueva was professional, knowledgeable, and didn’t beat around the bush. The turnaround time was fast and the team was very efficient. I would highly recommend Dales Auto Services!

reviews.author: Page Wright
reviews.text: I called to see if I could bring my truck in on the first of September. They said bring it in on the seventh. Everyday they said they were about to get to it. End of story it’s the 17th and they never looked at it. I went and picked it up. They could be honest about when they would get to it. Now the breaks are all the way out and I have took some else that would have looked instead now having to tow. I would advice not taking it to them unless you don’t really care when you get it back because they surely don’t like to be honest of get to them in a timely manner

reviews.author: Jordan Ray
reviews.text: Dale's Auto Service was very helpful they tuned up my engine and fixed my vacuum leak on my carburetor. Dale did a great job was fairly priced and told me what all he did. I was very pleased!

reviews.author: Dwain Haynes
reviews.text: I have been taking my family's vehicles to Dale's for 10 years. They are honest and they do great work. They have been able to work on my diesel truck, my wife's Audi and my son's Pontiac. Don't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Sue Victor
reviews.text: Great pricing and services. Very efficient, knowledgeable, and through. We take both our cars to Dale’s, and I would not take them anywhere else! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Colette Summitt
reviews.text: Dale's was recommended to me by a male friend who frequently buys cars. He said, Dale's has always done a great job for me and they are fair. That was at least 4 years ago and his recommendation was correct. As a woman, that is most important because auto mechanics is not my strong suite.

reviews.author: Fred De Stefano
reviews.text: Very nice people. Always come in with information about what is wrong or noticed with vehicle. Give them info on importance of timely fix especially if problem has just occured. If they knock your socks off give them nice money like I do. I've had some terrible mechanics, which I won't burn or hurt their families financially or online. Dale's has a right to make my money :)

reviews.author: Awakened Heart
reviews.text: Great service and friendly people!!! I was from out of town and my car broke down. They were full of work and people and took me in right away and helped me to get back in the road. Trustworthy and excellent service!! Can’t say enough about Dales!!!!

reviews.author: Julie Thomas
reviews.text: I LOVE LOVE LOVE Dales! I wish it was closer to my house. They have always been so honest with us. They never make me feel silly for asking a question. They go above and beyond for customer service. VERY honest and fair something you never see in an auto shop anymore.

reviews.author: Anthony Michael
reviews.text: Complete scam artists. $400 for brakes and rotors only to have to be done again because they used the wrong pads, over $700 for a cooling motor replacement that only took a couple minutes. They also forgot to put the panel back on when they were done. Save your money. These guys suck!

reviews.author: F.Luk
reviews.text: Excellent service, honest mechanics who don't try to sell u services you don't need, and the prices are the most reasonable in Hendersonville that I have seen. My go to mechanic is dales auto for Hendersonville.

reviews.author: Trev Hollifield
reviews.text: Was told give them a minute so I sat right outside and after they was thru with the customer I waited and made eye contact several time before I had to walk in and ask if they were ready. I guess it is a lot to signal or even for them to take a couple steps to make the next customer in line aware that they’re next. I’d go elsewhere just as I did

reviews.author: Sam Justus
reviews.text: Very professional, always upfront with any thing that you are having done. Have used them for many years. Dale,Doug and Joe do a wonderful job. Thanks so very much.

reviews.author: Cindy Arriaga
reviews.text: If I could give less than one star I would have. First off if you are a woman DO NOT go to this shop. They think women know nothing about cars, and take advantage of women. Secondly we have been going to this shop for 2 years and only had one other problem with them, but recently we went in for a simple oil change (which btw they over charge for) and then I ended up having to get my car towed to the shop a few days later from 40 minutes away! IDK if they hired different staff or what the deal is, but they never do a thorough job. A simple oil change turned into them screwing up then blaming the timing belt falling off bc it was wet. Then it was a pulley, then it was my fault. Come on do your job and enough with the petty crap. Now they are saying my breaks that were not making any noise are now making noise bc they are wet. I'm over this place and with all the good reviews am very shocked at this outcome!!! I will never go here again, and they have lost a two car households business.

reviews.author: Kym Borg
reviews.text: I called around the week of Thanksgiving, told them what was going on, which was something electrical. They said ok bring it in on this day, which was about a week later. Ok fine. Bring it in the day before so they can look at it the next day. After 2 days I still never heard about what was going on. Called them, they said they never got it in yet, if not that day for sure the next day. 2 days later still nothing. Called again. Was told well if you just drop the car off work no appointment we take it in between cars with appointment. So right there I almost pulled the car off the lot since I watched them put me down. Finally about a week later I get a call saying it's a certain part. It made sense so I had them fix it. Get the call saying the car was done but they couldn't get my airbag light to go off and my horn wasn't working yet and that it was another $400 part, but I didn't necessarily need it. Didn't make sense, usually when you put a part in you get better results or the same. Horn didn't n work which is why I wanted them to look at it, but the airbag light was never always on. Picked the car up, made it a block and turned around and brought it back because it wasn't fixed. Told them that and that last time my horn was fixed they said it was just a loose wire. Then all of a sudden after looking at it for another half hour they said they thought they found the problem, they'd work on it tomorrow. Got a call the next day saying it was fixed but still couldn't get my airbag light to turn off and that there is no wire to my horn. I asked if they could put the old part back in and they insisted that it was bad yet. So after nearly 4 weeks of having the car at least I can drive it, but I don't believe a word they told me. Took the car elsewhere for a different problem and got a second opinion and the horn magically works now for free besides. With the airbag light still on and my fog lights not turning on when I turn my lights on anymore, I'm waiting for the car to burn cuz they have stuff hooked up wrong yet. If they didn't lie to me and take all my money, I would pay someone else to fix it right. Never again!

reviews.author: Lane Heffner
reviews.text: I have been using Dale's Auto for nearly a decade now. Does great work at a fair price and has 2 guys working the front the desk that provides great customer service.

reviews.author: Maggie Jones
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good about this place...the professional way they listened and answered my questions. They called when it was ready, the price was more than reasonable. They have my trust and appreciation!

reviews.author: Jackie Burks
reviews.text: Took time with me to explain what and why my car was having trouble. Great staff and great set up. Prices are really good. Would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Tina Zirkle
reviews.text: Incredible work in a timely manner. Ronnie was so pleasant to work with. The place is clean to have a car worked on and very organized. Never have been to such an efficient auto repair with amazing people.

reviews.author: madison mckenzie
reviews.text: Had my car towed to this shop, and it was looked over and fixed, ready to go when they opened the next morning. Best experience I could have asked for. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Ron Castellucci
reviews.text: Honest, competent, friendly. Best auto repair shop I've ever used. When I leave my car with Dale's, I'm confident the job will be done right.

reviews.author: M. Anderson
reviews.text: Paid $900 to replace a oil gasket on my car two weeks later my engine is blown now I'm without my money and my car and they didn't care at all.

reviews.author: Danai Fundora
reviews.text: I would give Dale 10 stars if that rating existed. Super fast, excellent work, excellent communication. I will never use another Auto repair shop. Thank you, Dale!

reviews.author: Dan Solazzo
reviews.text: The shop is the best that I could come across. When I needed something done right away they took care of me. Thanks Dale you are the best in my eyes.

reviews.author: ken stepp
reviews.text: My old Jeep steers like new. Very reasonable price and the quoted price. Very professional and friendly staff. Couldn't be more pleased.

reviews.author: Brad Rakow
reviews.text: We have taken our vehicles here since we moved to the area two years ago and have been very pleased with the service and quality of work.

reviews.author: Tire Country
reviews.text: Since we closed our garage a few years ago I send anyone who needs cars worked on to Dale's.Very good prices and honest garage.

reviews.author: Daniel Climenhaga
reviews.text: Whata great place too have a vehicle serviced , finally found a really good shop too take my vehicle too Awesome mechanics and really good people too deal with .

reviews.author: David Emmons
reviews.text: Dale's Auto is the best in town! They always take the best care of our vehicles and their personal touch and attention to detail keeps us coming back!

reviews.author: Natalie Thomas
reviews.text: Great place to have your car serviced. They stay very busy. I feel they are a very trustworthy mechanics to deal with.

reviews.author: Pat Stines
reviews.text: Had a battery problem that I thought was a “shot” turned out that Dales tech found a loose connection at the battery! No charge!! I will highly recommend them and will use again if needed!!!!!!

reviews.author: Schrix Zirack
reviews.text: Great staff, great work. I would suggest going here first everytime you have an issue. If it's not their expertise, they know who to suggest too.

reviews.author: Adam Myslinski
reviews.text: I have taken my vehicles to this place now multiple times and each and every single time they have diagnosed the problems correctly and within reasonably priced. I will not take my vehicles anywhere else at all. They stay in contact and go above and beyond.

reviews.author: Joseph Vallini
reviews.text: Was given an estimate for work and then it was a bit more than I was expecting but I am very happy with the service and the way they were about doing what they can do.

reviews.author: Teak Lastein
reviews.text: Great group of mechanics. Been going here since it was known as Garys. Great history to the quality and care given to fixing up you vehicle.

reviews.author: Buddy O
reviews.text: This was my first visit and the technician explained what he was going to do beforehand. The price was equal or lower than two or three other shops.

reviews.author: Greg King
reviews.text: Great company!!!!! They stand behind there work and will not rip you off. I refer all my friends here

reviews.author: Meagan Smythe
reviews.text: Didn’t charge me to diagnose the issue I was having and referred me to an incredible specialist in the area to resolve my transmission problem. Thank you!

reviews.author: Rebecca Lemons Southerland
reviews.text: They are very experienced and helpful finding out what's wrong with your vehicle! Need something fixed on your vehicle see them!

reviews.author: Dena Perdue
reviews.text: Sent my mother here to get her battery installed because other place said there was too much corrosion. He took care of her right away and charged her much less than she was quoted at other places.

reviews.author: Paula Van meter
reviews.text: Unable to work on my car ,however thats wasn't the issue . Joe was not empathic whatsoever to help me find somewhere else to go as my car was undriveable. Just disappointed

reviews.author: Stephanie Watts
reviews.text: I LOVE DALES AUTO HE IS A GOOD HONEST MAN.I HAVE ALWAYS BEEN PLEASED WITH EVERTHING HE HS DONE FOR ME... HE IS STRAIGHT UP. I LIKE THAT YOU CANT FIND PEOPLE LIKE THAT ANYMORE.

reviews.author: Mary Brown
reviews.text: Very nice, knowledgeable folks. Didn't make me feel dumb or try to get money out of me. Would recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Bobby Mcpeters
reviews.text: My experience here is hard work making the best to make sure our customers get the best quality of work possible!

reviews.author: Hope Hreha
reviews.text: Everyone is always very friendly! Never had to wait more than a couple of minutes to get my car inspected.
